dataset_split: fixed test split, Pneumonia-positive images only

predicted_box_area_pixels_squared.definition: Across all retained predicted boxes at the original DICOM resolution

ground_truth_box_area_pixels_squared.definition: Across all positive RSNA ground-truth boxes at the original DICOM resolution

predicted_to_ground_truth_area_ratio.definition: Per-image total predicted box area divided by total ground-truth box area; includes images with no predicted boxes

failure_categories.irrelevant_anatomical_activation: The selected example's hotspot is centered below the annotated pulmonary opacity, in lower central/diaphragmatic anatomy.
